layouts.name: Autodromo Miguel E Abed
layouts.description: Draft association of the supplied venue-level entry to the existing independently mapped full course at Autódromo Miguel E. Abed. This venue has one supplied entry and one retained independent course, with a timing point on that course. Source trace distance 3427.5 m; supplied distance 3328 m. The association preserves the independent source geometry and remains provisional where corner configurations or historical distances differ.
